MktCalcInsightObjectDef.expression: SELECT Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.flavor__c AS flavor__c, Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.nicotine_level__c AS nicotine_level__c, CONCAT(Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.flavor__c, '-', Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.nicotine_level__c) AS flavor_nicotine_combo__c, COUNT(*) AS combo_count__c, ssot__Account__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS Account_ID__c FROM Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm JOIN ssot__Account__dlm ON Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.KQ_retail_number11__c = ssot__Account__dlm.ssot__Id__c JOIN Account_Revenue_Tier__cio ON ssot__Account__dlm.ssot__Id__c = Account_Revenue_Tier__cio.Account_ID__c WHERE Account_Revenue_Tier__cio.CI_Account_Revenue_Tier__c = 'Top 20%' AND Account_Revenue_Tier__cio.revenue_rank__c <= 10 AND Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.flavor__c <> 'Other' GROUP BY Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.flavor__c, Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.nicotine_level__c, CONCAT(Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.flavor__c, '-', Final_FRE_ZYN__dlm.nicotine_level__c), ssot__Account__dlm.ssot__Id__c
